_note: Secret vault timings, in seconds unless the key says otherwise; distances in 1920x1080 pixels, angles in degrees. A [min, max] list is picked at random in between. A shake is amp * e^(-decay * a) * sin(rad_per_s * a), for dur_s after its event (a = time since it).

kick_door._note: After Mr.Caspian's kick the door starts to shut shut_after_s later, pace times faster than usual.

gate._note: The vault door. It rolls travel_px into the wall beside the doorway; moving in zoom_in times, the doorway fills the screen. slow (after the unlock), fast (an open vault) and close: the wheel's turns over spin_s (closing, from spin_at_s), the bolts from bolts_at_s over bolts_s, the roll from roll_at_s over roll_s, the push in (out) over push_s, which starts push_overlap_s before the roll ends. Seating, the door shakes slam_px, and bolts_slam_factor of that when the bolts shut. A turned key is at turned_deg (outBack with key_overshoot). Unlocking, the keys turn delay_s in, turn_s each, stagger_s apart, and the door opens door_after_s after the last.

panel._note: The hint panel drops in over in_s (outBack with overshoot) from in_rise_px above its own height, and leaves over out_s, out_rise_px above.

weeds._note: Each seaweed of Layout.sea.weeds sways sway_deg every period_s.

fish._note: A fish swims at speed_px_per_s, bobbing bob_px at bob_hz, its tilt wobbling tilt_wobble_deg. The first comes after first_s, then one every every_s; the start_fish already there are start_along their way.

bubble._note: per_s bubbles a second rise at rise_px_per_s, wobbling wobble_px at wobble_hz, fading in over fade_in_s.

caspian._note: Mr.Caspian's text types chars_per_s letters a second, a voice blip every blip_every letters. He hops (change_hop) when his face changes, nods (nod_hop) when it stays, hops kick_hop at the kick. A laugh bounces him bounce_px at hz for laugh_s. He breathes (scale amp every period_s).

hop._note: Squash over squash_s (scale 1 + squash_x, 1 - squash_y), rise over rise_s (scale 1 - stretch_x, 1 + stretch_y, height_px up), settle over settle_s (settle_wobbles half-turns, scale 1 + settle_x, 1 - settle_y); all times the hop amount.

cards._note: The cards roll to the chosen one at roll_rate_per_s and pop in over enter_s from enter_start_scale (outBack with enter_overshoot); hidden, they drop hide_drop_px. A card without a key shakes sideways. Asked to confirm, the front card rises (confirm_lift) and its question pulses (amp at hz, after a pop over pop_s). The chip of the chest in focus is drawn at scale, pulsing amp once a second.

chest_open._note: A chest being opened, in seconds from the start.

timeline._note: The chest drops at drop_at_s and falls for fall_s; the key comes at key_at_s, flies for fly_s and pushes in for push_s; it turns from turn_at_s (wind_s back, turn_s past the quarter, settle_s). keyin_click_s / turn_clunk_s: where KeyIn.ogg's click and KeyTurn.ogg's bolt sit in their files, so they land as the key gets home and on the turn's furthest point. A snapped key shatters shatter_after_s after after_s, a good one opens open_after_s after it; Mr.Caspian talks snap_talk_after_s after the shatter or key_talk_after_s after the opening, the reward modal comes modal_after_s after it. The won key pops over pop_s; the chest leaves over leave_s. The fall's whoosh plays whoosh_lead_s early; the chest shows show_lead_s before the drop.

fall._note: The chest falls from from_y to the desk, narrowing by squash_x and stretching by stretch_y, its turn from rot_deg easing out with the power rot_ease_pow.

bounces._note: On the desk, one after the other: the slam (scale 1 + slam_x, 1 - slam_y), the first bounce (bounce1_px up, stretched by bounce1_stretch, turned bounce1_rot_deg), its knock, the second small bounce, its knock.

key._note: The key, seen from the front: it touches the keyhole at touch_scale of its home scale, coming from (start_x, start_y) off the keyhole at depth start_depth (1 = the keyhole), turned start_rot_deg and seen start_yaw from the side (1 = end-on). Pushed in, it goes past home to push_back_scale for push_split of the push, then back. It winds back wind_deg, turns past turned_deg by over_deg, and settles over settle_turns half-turns of a cosine. A key about to snap shakes snap_shake_deg.

shards._note: A broken key falls apart in cols x rows pieces, thrown out (out_speed along its direction from the keyhole, side_speed, rise_speed, toss_speed up) and spinning, falling at gravity px/s2; they fade over fade_s from fade_after_s.

landing._note: The chest landing throws count puffs, the first dust_count dust and the rest bubbles, slowed by drag_x / drag_y a second, falling at gravity, at opacity; the camera shakes shake_px for shake_s.

camera._note: While the camera shakes it zooms in shake_zoom more, easing back over shake_zoom_s.

punch._note: The punched chest, in seconds from the hit: the hit stop (jittering jitter_px at jitter_hz, squashed), then the flight to the floor (from depth chest_depth to land_depth at x land_x in the room's space, arc_px over its straight path, turning tumble_deg, slowed by the water with the power water_pow; past behind_depth it is drawn behind Mr.Caspian, shaded far_shade at the end); on the floor a squash, one hop, a knock; it fades over fade_s from fade_after_s after landing. Mr.Caspian says hey hey_after_s after the hit. The impact flash grows from flash_scale by flash_grow over flash_s, turned up to rot_deg; the camera shakes shake_px for shake_s.

kick._note: The kick, in seconds from it: the boot's flash (from flash_scale, growing by flash_grow over flash_s, turned up to rot_deg), the jolt (jolt_px for jolt_s, twisting jolt_twist_deg, zooming jolt_zoom more), then the view tumbles once from tumble_at_s over tumble_s.

open._note: The lid opening swells the chest (x, y) over hump_s.

leave._note: Leaving, the chest rises rise_px and the won key won_rise_px.

won_key._note: The won key rises from rise_from_dy over the desk to Layout.chest.won_y, delay_s after the opening (outBack with overshoot over the pop), bobbing bob_px; it spins spin_deg down to rot_deg, scales from scale[1] to scale[2] and fades in fade_speed times faster than it pops.

banner._note: The banner fades in over fade_s, delay_s plus after_pop of the pop after the opening, popping from 1 + pop_grow (outBack with overshoot); it fades out over out_s as the chest leaves.
